answer: A new voice enters only behind sponsors: an operator’s kth live head needs a sponsor committee larger than all its earlier committees combined, pairwise disjoint and sharing no wharf, knoll or zephyr with those heads or each other; each sponsor locks one bond on a distinct wharf, signs one knoll fix, files one zephyr trace, and overlap folds heads and slashes bonds. First: 1 bond; then 2, 4, 8—n clones cost 2^n−1 sponsor bonds, i.e. bribing unrelated operators.
